notes: Runs the program's %fiveobs macro (proc print data=&dsn(obs=5) with a TITLE) against the four SLC frequency-sweep tables (isolation, reflection, total_coupling, transmission). The tables are loaded from the frequency values shipped in the repo's *_data.csv companions via inline DATALINES, preserving the exact column names (Frequency_GHz, Isolation_Ant1_2_dB, S11_dB, ...); the upstream sas7bdat libname (d:/lgs) is not available off-platform. First-5-obs output matches the program's own inline-documented listing.
